'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[United States Secretary of State|US Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] announces that the [[United States]] will provide another $275 million in additional military aid to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-provide-ukraine-with-275-mln-military-aid-blinken-says-2022-10-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
***[[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Minister]] [[Sergei Shoigu]] announces the end of the mobilization campaign as 300,000 reservists are reached. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-10-29/zelenskyy-accuses-russia-of-mass-theft-of-medical-equipment/101593288 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two [[Palestinian Civil Defence]] members are killed, and another is injured when [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] open fire on a vehicle at a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] in [[Nablus]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/28/israeli-forces-kill-two-palestinians-in-occupied-nablus (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Haitian crisis]]
**[[Rally of Progressive National Democrats]] leader and former [[November 2016 Haitian presidential election|presidential candidate]] [[Eric Jean Baptiste]] is assassinated outside his residence in [[Port-au-Prince]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/29/americas/haiti-politician-killed-violence-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least 42 people are killed by floods and [[landslide]]s caused by [[Tropical Storm Nalgae (2022)|Tropical Storm Nalgae (Paeng)]] in [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/floods-landslides-philippines-south-kill-least-26-govt-official-2022-10-28/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korean President]] [[Yoon Suk-yeol]] denies that his country is sending weapons to [[Ukraine]] after [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] made a reference to [[South Korea]] during a conference yesterday. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/28/south-korea-denies-sending-weapons-to-ukraine-after-putin-remark (Al Jazeera)]
*[[China–Germany relations]]
**Authorities in the [[Germany|German]] [[States of Germany|state]] of [[Hesse]] announce that they will investigate claims by the NGO [[Safeguard Defenders]] that [[China]] operates an illegal police station in [[Frankfurt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/german-authorities-looking-into-reports-illegal-chinese-police-frankfurt-2022-10-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 Premiership Rugby]]
**The [[Rugby Football Union]] confirms that [[Wasps RFC|Wasps]] have been suspended for the remainder of the season and are [[Relegation|relegated]] to the [[RFU Championship]], the second tier of the [[English rugby union system]], next season after the team had entered [[Administration (law)|administration]] earlier in the month for reaching more than [[Pound sterling|£]]100 million in debt. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/28/wasps-suspended-from-premiership-as-rfu-confirms-relegation (''The Guardian'')]
